newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian MinFins bide time until US rates known.
newsitem.headline: Russian MinFins bide time until US rates known.

text.p: Prices of Russian MinFin bonds eased on Tuesday but few deals were struck as the market waited to see if the Federal Reserve would raise interest rates, dealers said.

They added the market had already largely priced in a 25 basis-point hike in U.S. rates and one trader said MinFins, trading on relief, could follow a possible rally in U.S. Treasuries if the 25 bp raise were announced.
The U.S. Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) meets on Tuesday to discuss interest rates.

"Nobody would do anything until rates are known. Selling on expectation of a 0.25 (percentage point) hike is over but banks are fearing to buy -- who knows what foreigners will do as the rates are announced," a Russian bank dealer said.
The FOMC decision on interest rates is expected around 1915 GMT. Dealers forecast much higher activity on all emerging markets, MinFins as well.
"If rates are raised 0.25 point as expected, the market will feel relief. There should be a rally in U.S. Treasuries and MinFins could track them," a Deutsche Morgan Grenfell dealer said.
But he added the upside potential was limited as operators were mainly seen in long positions.
